title: 【大分県 】由布院温泉 〜行き方・日帰り温泉・オススメの旅館など〜
titleTranslation: 【Oita Prefecture】 Yufuin Onsen — How to Get There, Day-Trip Hot Springs, Recommended Inns
summary: This article introduces Yufuin Onsen in Oita Prefecture, covering its health benefits, how to get there from Tokyo and Osaka, recommended day-trip baths and inns, and nearby sightseeing spots.

sentences.text: 大分県の　由布院温泉は、家族や　友達と　いく人が　多い　人気の　温泉です。
sentences.translation: Yufuin Onsen in Oita Prefecture is a popular hot spring that many people visit with family or friends.

sentences.text: 山を　みながら　はいる　露天風呂も　あります。
sentences.translation: There is also an open-air bath where you can bathe while looking at the mountains.

sentences.text: 湯布院温泉への　行き方や　日帰り温泉、オススメの　旅館などを　紹介します。

tokens.gloss: way of doing (as in 行き方 "how to go")

sentences.translation: We will introduce how to get to Yufuin Onsen, day-trip hot springs, and recommended inns.

sentences.text: 由布院温泉とは
sentences.translation: About Yufuin Onsen

sentences.text: 九州地方の　大分県にある　由布院温泉は、家族や　友達と　行く人が　多い　人気の　温泉です。
sentences.translation: Yufuin Onsen, located in Oita Prefecture in the Kyushu region, is a popular hot spring that many people visit with family or friends.

sentences.text: 由布岳という　山を　見ながら　入ることができる　露天風呂も　あります。

tokens.gloss: to say, called (as in という)

sentences.translation: There is also an open-air bath where you can bathe while looking at a mountain called Mt. Yufu.

sentences.text: 温泉街では、食事や　スイーツを　楽しんだり、雑貨を　見たり、美術館に　行ったり、ゆっくり　できます。
sentences.translation: In the hot spring town, you can relax by enjoying meals and sweets, looking at general goods, and visiting museums.

sentences.text: 由布院温泉の　効能や　行き方、オススメの　旅館などを　紹介します。

tokens.gloss: way of doing (as in 行き方 "how to go")

sentences.translation: We will introduce the health benefits of Yufuin Onsen, how to get there, and recommended inns.

sentences.text: 由布院温泉の　効能
sentences.translation: The Health Benefits of Yufuin Onsen

sentences.text: 由布院温泉の　温泉は、無色透明の　温泉です。
sentences.translation: The hot spring water of Yufuin Onsen is colorless and transparent.

sentences.text: その温泉に　入れば　ストレスや　疲れを　取ることが　できるでしょう。
sentences.translation: If you bathe in that hot spring, you can probably relieve stress and fatigue.

sentences.text: たくさん　ある　温泉の　なかには　天然保湿成分が　たくさん　入っている　青い　温泉も　あって、女の人に　とても　人気です。
sentences.translation: Among the many hot springs, there is also a blue hot spring containing lots of natural moisturizing ingredients, which is very popular with women.

sentences.text: 由布院温泉の　行き方

tokens.gloss: way of doing (as in 行き方 "how to go")

sentences.translation: How to Get to Yufuin Onsen

sentences.text: 東京や　大阪から　由布院温泉に　行くときの　行き方を　紹介します。

tokens.gloss: way of doing (as in 行き方 "how to go")

sentences.translation: We will introduce how to get to Yufuin Onsen from Tokyo or Osaka.

sentences.text: 東京から　由布院温泉に　行くとき
sentences.translation: When Going to Yufuin Onsen from Tokyo

sentences.text: 飛行機で　行く
sentences.translation: Going by Airplane

sentences.text: 羽田空港か　成田空港から　大分空港へ　行きます。
sentences.translation: Go from Haneda Airport or Narita Airport to Oita Airport.

sentences.text: 羽田空港から　行くときは、　だいたい　1時間35分ぐらい　かかります。
sentences.translation: Going from Haneda Airport takes about 1 hour and 35 minutes.

sentences.text: 成田空港から　行くときは、　2時間ぐらい　かかります。
sentences.translation: Going from Narita Airport takes about 2 hours.

sentences.text: 飛行機の　チケットの　値段は　10,000円〜30,000円ぐらいです。
sentences.translation: The price of the plane ticket is about 10,000 to 30,000 yen.

sentences.text: 空港からは　亀の井バスに　乗って、由布院駅前バスセンターで　おります。
sentences.translation: From the airport, take the Kamenoi Bus and get off at Yufuin Station-mae Bus Center.

sentences.text: 55分ぐらい　かかります。
sentences.translation: It takes about 55 minutes.

sentences.text: バスの　切符の　値段は　2,000円です。
sentences.translation: The bus ticket costs 2,000 yen.

sentences.text: 新幹線で　行く
sentences.translation: Going by Shinkansen

sentences.text: 東京駅から　新幹線で　博多駅まで　行って、JR特急ゆふいんの森に　乗り換えて　由布院駅で　おります。
sentences.translation: Take the shinkansen from Tokyo Station to Hakata Station, then transfer to the JR limited express Yufuin no Mori and get off at Yufuin Station.

sentences.text: 時間は　7時間30分ぐらい　かかります。
sentences.translation: It takes about 7 hours and 30 minutes.

sentences.text: 切符の　値段は　ぜんぶで　29,500円ぐらいです。
sentences.translation: The total ticket price is about 29,500 yen.

sentences.text: 大阪から　由布院温泉へ　行くとき
sentences.translation: When Going to Yufuin Onsen from Osaka

sentences.text: 新幹線で　行く
sentences.translation: Going by Shinkansen

sentences.text: 新大阪駅から　新幹線で　博多駅まで　行きます。
sentences.translation: Take the shinkansen from Shin-Osaka Station to Hakata Station.

sentences.text: 博多駅で　特急ゆふいんの森に　乗り換えて　由布院駅で　おります。
sentences.translation: Transfer to the limited express Yufuin no Mori at Hakata Station and get off at Yufuin Station.

sentences.text: 時間は　5時間ぐらい　かかります。
sentences.translation: It takes about 5 hours.

sentences.text: 切符の　値段は、　ぜんぶで　21,710円ぐらいです。
sentences.translation: The total ticket price is about 21,710 yen.

sentences.text: フェリーで　行く
sentences.translation: Going by Ferry

sentences.text: 大阪南港から　フェリー「さんふらわあ」に　乗って、別府観光港に　行きます。
sentences.translation: Take the ferry "Sunflower" from Osaka Nanko and go to Beppu Kanko Port.

sentences.text: 夜に　フェリーに　乗って、寝ている間に　別府観光港に　行くことが　できます。
sentences.translation: You can board the ferry at night and arrive at Beppu Kanko Port while you sleep.

sentences.text: 時間は、11時間50分ぐらい　かかります。
sentences.translation: It takes about 11 hours and 50 minutes.

sentences.text: 船に　乗る　切符の　値段は、部屋や、　乗るときによって　違いますが　12,280円〜です。
sentences.translation: The ferry ticket price varies depending on the room and time of boarding, but starts at 12,280 yen.

sentences.text: 船を　おりたら、九州産交バスに　乗って　由布院駅前まで　行きます。

tokens.reading: きゅうしゅうさんこうばす

sentences.translation: After getting off the ship, take the Kyushu Sanko Bus to Yufuin Station.

sentences.text: 時間は　1時間ぐらい　かかります。
sentences.translation: It takes about 1 hour.

sentences.text: 切符の　値段は　1,100円です。
sentences.translation: The ticket costs 1,100 yen.

sentences.translation: There is a very large open-air bath where you can bathe while looking at Mt. Yufu.

sentences.text: 男の人の　露天風呂は、だいたい　180㎡ぐらい、女の人の　露天風呂は　270㎡以上です！
sentences.translation: The men's open-air bath is about 180 square meters, and the women's open-air bath is over 270 square meters!

sentences.translation: There is a 30,000 square meter garden with cherry and maple trees, and it also contains an open-air bath and a large bath.

sentences.translation: It is one of the inns called the "Big Three" of Yufuin Onsen (Kamenoi Bessou, Yufuin Tamanoyu, and Sanso Murata).

sentences.translation: The open-air bath with a view of Mt. Yufu is a place where you can see a wonderful view!

sentences.text: 旅館には　33,000㎡の　とても　広い　庭園が　あります。
sentences.translation: The inn has a very large 33,000 square meter garden.

sentences.text: そこには、桜や、ミズバショウ、ツツジ、モミジなどが　あり、ホタルが　いる　小さい　川も　あります。
sentences.translation: There you'll find cherry blossoms, skunk cabbage, azaleas, maples and more, as well as a small river with fireflies.

sentences.text: 春・夏・秋・冬、ぜんぶの　季節で　違う　景色を　楽しむことが　できます。
sentences.translation: You can enjoy different scenery in every season — spring, summer, autumn, and winter.

sentences.text: 由布院温泉に　行ったら、湯の坪街道を　歩いてみましょう。

tokens.gloss: tsubo (unit; part of place name Yunotsubo)

sentences.translation: If you go to Yufuin Onsen, let's try walking along Yunotsubo Kaido.

sentences.text: 湯の坪街道まで　JR由布院駅から　歩いて　5分ぐらい　かかります。

tokens.gloss: tsubo (unit; part of place name Yunotsubo)

sentences.translation: It takes about 5 minutes on foot from JR Yufuin Station to Yunotsubo Kaido.

sentences.text: 湯の坪街道には　お土産や　甘いものを　売っている　店や　レストランなどが　たくさん　並んでいます。

tokens.gloss: tsubo (unit; part of place name Yunotsubo)
to line up, be lined up

sentences.translation: Along Yunotsubo Kaido, many shops and restaurants selling souvenirs and sweets line the street.

sentences.text: 湯の坪街道を　25分ぐらい　歩くと　金鱗湖に　つきます。

tokens.gloss: tsubo (unit; part of place name Yunotsubo)

sentences.translation: If you walk along Yunotsubo Kaido for about 25 minutes, you will arrive at Lake Kinrin.

sentences.text: 湖の　底から　澄んだ　水と　温泉が　湧いている　湖で、1年中　水温が　高いです。
sentences.translation: It is a lake where clear water and hot spring water well up from the bottom, and the water temperature stays high all year round.

sentences.text: 冬の　朝、早い時間には　湖に　霧が　出て、幻想的な　景色を　見ることが　できます。
sentences.translation: On winter mornings, early in the day, fog rises over the lake, and you can see a fantastical view.

sentences.text: 由布院には　観光辻馬車が　あります。
sentences.translation: In Yufuin, there are sightseeing horse-drawn carriages.

sentences.text: パッカパッカと　馬の　蹄の　音は　とても　のどかです。
sentences.translation: The clip-clop sound of the horse's hooves is very peaceful.

sentences.text: スカーボロという　観光乗り合いタクシーや　観光人力車、レンタサイクルにも　乗ることが　できます。

tokens.gloss: Scarborough (name of a sightseeing taxi service)
to say, called (as in という)

sentences.translation: You can also ride a sightseeing shared taxi called "Scarborough," a sightseeing rickshaw, or a rental bicycle.

sentences.text: COMICO ART MUSEUM YUFUINや　由布院ステンドグラス美術館など　美術館もあるので　ぜひ　行ってみて　ください。

tokens.gloss: to give (honorific, used in ～てください requests)

sentences.translation: There are also museums such as COMICO ART MUSEUM YUFUIN and the Yufuin Stained Glass Museum, so please be sure to visit.

sentences.text: 温泉の　入り方は、「知っておきたい、日本のお風呂・温泉・銭湯の文化とマナー」の　記事で　確認してくださいね。

to do in advance (as in ～ておく)
to give (honorific, used in ～てください requests)

sentences.translation: Please check the article "Bathing Culture and Manners in Japan's Baths, Hot Springs, and Public Baths You Should Know" for how to bathe in a hot spring.

sentences.translation: *Times and ticket prices for planes, shinkansen, buses, etc., as well as bathing fees, are written based on official websites checked in January 2024.
